description: Upload a JPG/JPEG image for MMS (POST /sms/v2/services/{serviceId}/files; JSON with Base64 body, not multipart). ≤300 KB, ≤1500x1440, kept 6 days. Returns fileId for ncloud_sens_send_sms files[]. A file with the same name and size is reused.

fileBody.description: Base64-encoded image (a 'data:image/...;base64,' prefix is stripped automatically)

serviceId.description: SMS service ID in NRN form (e.g. ncp:sms:kr:1********2:myproject). Defaults to NCLOUD_SENS_SMS_SERVICE_ID / NCLOUD_SENS_SERVICE_ID. Find it with ncloud_sens_list_projects (smsService.serviceId). A 'Forbidden' reply means the project does not have this channel enabled.

name: ncloud_sens_upload_sms_attachment
